title: Source
description: A page or API Mend pulls drug-programme data from. `controlled` marks a source we author ourselves — it is set on Meridian so the catalogue itself discloses that our break is our own.

url.title: Canonical URL
url.description: Never version-qualified. Activating a new page version must not change this.

controlled.title: Controlled source
controlled.description: true = we author this page. Disclosure, in the catalogue rather than only in the README.

has_api.title: Has an API
has_api.description: false is the whole point. Sources with APIs do not need Mend.

release_blocked.title: Release blocked
release_blocked.description: Set while health is degraded or failed. Downstream consumers must not publish from a blocked source.
